REQUEST
Write one Wan text-to-video prompt. A yellow paper boat drifts along a narrow rain-filled gutter beside a gray curb; raindrops ripple the water and push tiny leaves past it. The camera makes a slow low tracking move alongside the boat, then gently pulls back as it reaches a storm drain. Photorealistic macro cinematography, cool overcast light. Return one cohesive paragraph only, with no shot list, label, notes, variants, or generation.

OUTPUT A
A yellow paper boat drifts and gently bobs along a narrow rain-filled gutter beside a gray concrete curb, while falling raindrops spread overlapping ripples and nudge tiny leaves past its folded hull. In one continuous shot, the camera tracks slowly alongside at water level, then gently pulls back as the boat reaches a storm drain, revealing water streaming between the dark metal bars. Photorealistic macro cinematography, shallow depth of field, crisp paper creases, wet concrete textures, and cool overcast light reflected on the moving water.

OUTPUT B
A yellow paper boat drifts along a narrow rain-filled gutter beside a gray curb, its folded paper texture sharply detailed. Raindrops strike the water, spreading overlapping ripples that push tiny leaves past the boat. The camera tracks slowly alongside at water level, then gently pulls back as the boat reaches a storm drain. Photorealistic macro cinematography with shallow depth of field and cool, diffuse overcast light reflecting softly across the rainwater.

CRITERION C14-ROUTE (hard)
The output follows the existing Wan route as one cohesive cinematic paragraph rather than a shot list or image prompt.
